categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server initialization in src/httpserver.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents local cross-user RPC credential theft by requiring default IPv4 loopback binding to succeed. As noted in the description, when the IPv4 port is occupied, bitcoind currently fails open on IPv6 while writing out an RPC cookie that bitcoin-cli subsequently leaks to the rogue local process.
